world.title: 9 dead as business jet nose-dives into Florida, explodes into giant fireball
world.summary: A business jet carrying nine people crashed in a residential area near Cresthaven, Florida, on Sunday, resulting in the deaths of all on board. The aircraft was en route from Texas to the Bahamas when it nose-dived and exploded into a fireball. The National Transportation Safety Board has initiated an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the crash.

world.title: 9 dead as Florida jet crashes near busy roadway
world.summary: A Learjet 60 crashed into a South Florida neighborhood on Sunday, resulting in the deaths of all nine people on board. Emergency crews responded to the scene following the incident. US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed the fatalities. The crash occurred near a busy roadway, prompting an immediate investigation into the circumstances surrounding the accident.

world.title: Netanyahu pressing Trump to strike Iran immediately after midterms - Axios
world.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is urging US President Donald Trump to take military action against Iran following the midterm elections. However, Trump prefers to allow ongoing negotiations to continue. Meanwhile, Iranian officials have dismissed nuclear talks, insisting on their terms for peace and threatening military retaliation, despite ongoing diplomatic discussions mediated by Qatar.

business.title: Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Jio Platforms, M&M, CDSL, ITC, NTPC, IOCL and Hero MotoCorp
business.summary: Indian equity benchmarks closed higher on Friday, with the Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex showing significant gains. Major companies like Reliance Industries and Jio Platforms reported positive quarterly earnings, with Reliance Industries experiencing a 41% increase in net profit. Other firms, including Sun Pharma and Indian Oil Corporation, also noted substantial changes in their net profits.

business.title: KKR, Singtel and Tata Communications put data centre company STT GDC India up for sale at over $5.5 billion
business.summary: KKR, Singtel, and Tata Communications are preparing to sell STT Global Data Centres India, with an expected valuation exceeding $5.5 billion. This decision aims to enhance capital and refine strategic goals. STT GDC India operates 34 data centres and is a prominent co-location service provider, positioned to benefit from the growing demand for data infrastructure amid changing technology trends.

business.title: OpenAI might rebrand its data centers as ‘AI compute campuses’
business.summary: OpenAI is considering rebranding its data centers as "AI compute campuses" to improve public perception. Axios reports that the company plans a public relations campaign following the midterm elections, anticipating a shift in political power. The rebranding aims to address the negative views surrounding traditional data centers, potentially enhancing their image and acceptance in the technology landscape.

technology.title: This professional camera app gets my phone photos so right that post-processing feels unnecessary
technology.summary: A new professional camera app for smartphones offers impressive photo quality, minimizing the need for post-processing. Users appreciate its ability to deliver great results instantly, aligning with the desire for a seamless workflow. The app is free and open source, making it accessible for those seeking enhanced photography without the hassle of extensive editing after capturing images.

technology.title: NYT Strands hints and answers for Monday, November 2 (game #974)
technology.summary: The New York Times Strands game for November 2 offers hints and answers for players. Strands, a new word game from the NYT, follows popular formats like Wordle and Spelling Bee. While it can be challenging, players can find assistance through provided hints. Additional word-based games, such as NYT Connections, are also available for those seeking more fun.

technology.title: New Devices, Features and Trends
technology.summary: AI wearables are evolving beyond basic activity tracking to include features like conversation capture, hands-free assistance, and advanced health data insights. Notable devices include Amazon's Bee, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, and Qualcomm's wearable chips. These innovations reflect a significant trend in 2026, where technology integrates more deeply into daily life, enhancing both functionality and user experience in health monitoring.

sports.title: 'Most inexperienced bowling attack': Gautam Gambhir flags India's biggest challenge ahead of New Zealand ODIs
sports.summary: India's head coach Gautam Gambhir has highlighted the team's inexperienced bowling attack as the primary challenge ahead of the five-match ODI series against New Zealand. Gambhir emphasized the need for the bowlers to step up and perform effectively in the series. The team's lack of experience in this area could impact their overall performance against the New Zealand side.

sports.title: Beardman set for ODI debut, Harper, Fraser-McGurk, Shaw in T20 squad
sports.summary: Beardman is set to make his ODI debut, while Harper, Fraser-McGurk, and Shaw have been included in the T20 squad. Key players Cummins, Hazlewood, and Starc will be rested for the entire England ODI and T20I series. Additionally, Ellis is unavailable for ODIs, and David has not been selected, with Test batters also rested from T20Is.

sports.title: Player Ratings: Racing Santander 0-3 Real Madrid
sports.summary: Real Madrid secured a 3-0 victory against Racing Santander in their latest match. The performance showcased the team's strength and skill, contributing to their positive momentum in the league. Player ratings reflect individual contributions and overall team dynamics. Fans are encouraged to engage respectfully, adhering to community guidelines, and avoid any form of trolling or negative interactions.

health.title: Find your place in the sun with Vitamin D
health.summary: On Vitamin D Day, November 2, experts highlight that over 70% of Indians are deficient in Vitamin D despite ample sunlight. They recommend safe sun exposure and suggest daily intake of 600 to 2,000 IU, along with maintenance dosing. The emphasis is on the importance of regular sunlight for overall health and well-being.

health.title: Aster Medcity Organizes Cyclothon Emphasizing Awareness on Male Breast Cancer
health.summary: Aster Medcity hosted the ‘Ride for Life’ Cyclothon in Kochi to raise awareness for Breast Cancer Awareness Month. The event emphasized that breast cancer affects both men and women. Dr. Shuhaib Khader, COO of Aster Medcity, officially launched the cyclothon, aiming to educate the public about male breast cancer and promote early detection and treatment.

health.title: There’s new guidance on menopause symptoms like hot flashes. What women need to know
health.summary: The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) has updated its menopause management guidance for the first time in 12 years. The new recommendations emphasize the use of hormone therapies, alongside nonhormonal options, to alleviate symptoms such as hot flashes, night sweats, and sleep disturbances. Practical tips for managing these symptoms are also included in the updated guidance.

science.title: Einstein’s equations, if applied more carefully, may hold the answer to why the universe is expanding faster, without any need for mysterious dark energy, say scientists
science.summary: Scientists from the University of California propose that a more careful application of Einstein's equations could explain the universe's accelerating expansion without invoking dark energy. For nearly thirty years, dark energy has been the predominant theory for this phenomenon. The researchers suggest that reevaluating existing mathematical frameworks may provide alternative insights into cosmic expansion.

science.title: NASA Reaches Out To Commercial Space Industry For Help Saving Legendary Hubble Space Telescope
science.summary: NASA is seeking assistance from the commercial space industry to help preserve the Hubble Space Telescope, which has been operational since 1990. Although a mission to save Hubble is not scheduled to launch until 2032, planning efforts need to commence soon. The telescope has provided significant astronomical insights and iconic images over its more than three-decade history.

science.title: South Atlantic meteor detected by US military and weather satellites
science.summary: On April 1, 2026, a meteor illuminated the sky over the South Atlantic near Argentina. US military satellites first detected the event, followed by weather satellites from NOAA and European agencies. This collaboration enhances understanding of atmospheric entries and strengthens planetary defense strategies, showcasing the effectiveness of space technology in monitoring potential threats from space.
